decisions.reason: Reusing one website format does not change the requirement that each operational location has a separate Wix website and account.
The template-reuse decision does not change how visitors select a location or where the selection routes them.
The candidate already has a complete message-42 Event establishing unchanged packages and prices across reused location-site formats.
Sharing a website format across sites does not change the master site's role of consolidating brand, location, and informational content.
Location-specific branding adjustments do not necessarily change the established Smash Room brand name.
The reuse strategy does not modify the requirement to minimize SEO damage during the Bay Area migration.
Copying one website format across every site while changing only branding and wording necessarily extends the shared visual structure from the master site to location sites.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: But we’re essentially building one website format to use across every site. We would copy and paste it, changing only the branding and wording, while keeping all packages and prices unchanged.

decisions.reason: Reusing the website format does not change separate Wix accounts, payment setups, or payouts for each location.
The source decision does not change Wix as the location booking platform.
A shared website format does not change the isolation of bookings, calendars, reporting, revenue, or sales by location.
